name: ViStoryBench
description: ViStoryBench is a comprehensive benchmark suite for evaluating story visualization models. It features richly annotated multi-shot scripts from diverse narrative sources and includes automated metrics assessing character consistency, style similarity, prompt alignment, aesthetic quality, and generation artifacts, validated by human studies.
reputation: A recent benchmark that is gaining attention in the story visualization and multimodal generation community, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes multi-dimensional evaluation metrics validated by human studies; covers diverse narrative structures and artistic styles.
